key_idea: Count all height sequences in [0,h]^w with total at most n by a bounded knapsack DP, then subtract the flat scenes.
sketch: Cap n at w*h. dp[j] = number of ways for the columns so far to use exactly j inches; each new column adds 0..h, done with prefix sums in O(n) per column, O(w*n) = 1e6 total. Sum dp[0..n] and subtract the number of plains, min(h, n/w)+1 (every equal height including zero). Pitfalls: the all-zero scene is a plain too, and take the result modulo 1e9+7 without going negative.
